result.summary: Documents the rounding direction of CFeeRate::GetFee (rounds up) and CFeeRate::GetFeePerK (rounds down) in feerate.h. It also removes a special-case check in CFeeRate::GetFee that previously forced negative fees rounding to 0 to return -1 satoshi instead, making its output match EvaluateFeeUp directly.
result.problem: After fee calculation logic moved from the header into feerate.cpp, rounding semantics were not explicitly documented in the header. Additionally, an ad-hoc special case for negative feerates caused GetFee to diverge from EvaluateFeeUp by returning -1 satoshi instead of 0 when rounding fractional negative amounts toward positive infinity.
evidence: PR description: "Now that the impl moved into the C++ file in 38ece2a9c853ae3db9afb5215611c3e23e40461f, it could make sense to document the rounding behavior in the header file doxygen comment."

PR description: "Also, drop the 'special case', which seems more confusing than helpful. (It is only a special case for negative feerates, which are mostly irrelevant and only possible with manual fee prioritization deltas)"
result.changed_since_previous: The earlier description framed the PR as only updating documentation; the PR also deletes the runtime special-case check for negative fees in feerate.cpp and updates unit and fuzz tests.
result.card: This pull request documents rounding directions for CFeeRate getters in feerate.h and removes an ad-hoc special case in CFeeRate::GetFee that forced negative fees rounding to 0 satoshis to return -1. This cleans up internal consistency between CFeeRate::GetFee and FeeFrac::EvaluateFeeUp, which only affects transactions with negative effective feerates caused by manual prioritisation deltas. It simplifies fuzz testing by allowing an exact equality assertion against EvaluateFeeUp. No dependencies are noted.

risk.why: A flaw would only alter fee calculations for transactions assigned negative prioritisation deltas by at most one satoshi.
